title: YouTube publish kit: SRT and chapters
what_it_does: publish_kit.py transcribes the final render once, aligns it to the script, writes video.srt and chapters.txt (first chapter at 0:00, at least three, each 10 s or longer, short scenes merged into the previous one).
when_to_use: After the render, before uploading to YouTube.
why: Chapter rules are the valuable bit; the script depends on the toolkit's scene files and Scribe or Whisper, so write our own that reads our project's scenes.
